postal_system.assignment_rule: La Poste's complete official 2026-08-08 snapshot has exactly one 978-prefix commune row and exactly one 97150 row: INSEE 97801 Saint-Martin maps to 97150.
postal_system.geometry_rule: La Poste explicitly states that postal-code contours are not supplied in open data. The current geo.api.gouv.fr 97801 administrative MultiPolygon is used only because the complete official assignment denominator proves that Saint-Martin has one postcode. It remains derived display geometry and is never official postal, legal, survey, cadastral or delivery geometry.
postal_system.non_area_rule: No Point, route, P.O. box or organisation object is expanded into an area.
postal_system.address_rule: No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer, delivery or land-rights row is bundled. Postal Code to Polygon to Address Context authority remains separated.
postal_system.agid_rule: The postal node and derived administrative surface are linked only inside the versioned Postal Context graph. AGID identity, addresses and buildings require independent explicit evidence.

temporal_model.valid_time: The assignment is represented from the 2026-08-08 official La Poste data update.
temporal_model.known_time: Retrieval time, exact source bodies, edition, digests and AGID release time are recorded separately.
temporal_model.history_rule: A later assignment or boundary edition creates a new release and never rewrites this evidence.

quality_gates.pass: The full 39,192-row official snapshot has exactly one 978-prefix and one 97150 row, both the same 97801 assignment.
The fixed geo.api.gouv.fr response is MultiPolygon, has the same 97801/97150 identity, retains Open Licence 2.0 and is labelled derived.
All 11 parts, 11 closed rings and 2,136 positions pass Turf and JSTS validity checks without coordinate modification.
The real pack passes normalization, API lookup, metadata, bounds fit, translucent paint, clear, re-search and invalid-code tests.
No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer or land-rights data is published.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights and blockers are inventoried.
Country-specific contracts and provenance are reviewable.

A complete current official La Poste assignment snapshot proves that Saint-Martin has the single postcode 97150 and maps it to INSEE 97801; fixed Open Licence 2.0 geo.api.gouv.fr code and postcode responses supply the same real valid MultiPolygon without coordinate modification; it is published only as derived administrative display context, and the shared real API/app path normalizes, renders, fits, clears and re-searches it with provenance while rejecting invalid and non-area fabrication.
A source refresh and independent review pass without authority drift.
Two source refreshes pass with monitored rollback.
